title: ADAS levels explained
hook: No car in India can drive itself
caption:
"Level 2 ADAS" is on every brochure now, but what does it actually mean? 🤔

Quick version:
Level 0 = warnings only
Level 1 = one helper at a time (cruise OR steering)
Level 2 = the car can handle steering and speed together, but YOU are still the driver

No car on sale in India drives itself. ADAS is a co-pilot, not an autopilot. Treat it like a smart assistant that still needs supervision, just like that intern who's great but needs code review. 😄

Which ADAS feature would you actually use daily? Tell me in the comments 👇

New here? This page breaks down car tech in plain language, mainly for Indian buyers. Follow along.

slides.heading: No car in India can drive itself
Level 0: Warnings only
slides.body: Beeps for collisions or blind spots. You do all the driving.

slides.heading: Level 1: One helper at a time
slides.body: Adaptive cruise OR lane keep assist. Not both together.

slides.heading: Level 2: Steering plus speed
slides.body: The car can do both at once. You still supervise, hands on the wheel.

slides.heading: Cars in India top out at Level 2
slides.body: None of them drive themselves. Eyes on the road, always.
